supporting_evidence.summary: significant deviations in scope [all services]: recommendationservice_latency-90 z=2400.08 (12000.4%); recommendationservice_latency-50 z=178.29 (891.5%); frontend_latency-90 z=53.27 (286.5%); recommendationservice_cpu z=52.79 (620.8%)
traces for recommendationservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 0.96->2.92ms (3.03x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 3.79->57.01ms (15.04x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: A pure network delay would not raise CPU by 620.8% (z=52.79). Its own self-time also rose 3.03x, which points to compute work inside the service rather than a wire delay (E1, E2).

The all-services ranking shows no productcatalogservice deviation (E1). recommendationservice's own self-time, which excludes time spent in child calls, rose 0.96->2.92ms, so its slowness is local (E2).

proposed_fix.description: Find what is driving recommendationservice CPU (a runaway process or stress load) and stop it. Scale out or raise the CPU limit for recommendationservice until latency recovers.
